title: WP4/WP5 TOPO-2D-00 RANS results interchange (draft, not a scientific freeze)
description: All forces are dimensionless centre-section coefficients on the SAME c1=223.4 mm reference, drag=+Cx and downforce=-Cz, including E2/E3. Every force carries its observable: sharp-arm pressure_cl for Cp comparison, thick-arm total_cl for WaterLily. Difference only identical observables. Eight paired realisation records are supplied per model/family cell. E*_sharp means unthickened published coordinate originals including finite trailing-edge thickness. Duplicate mesh hashes make that config/model/family cell DEGENERATE_REALISATIONS: retain finite point estimates, emit no interval, ratio test INCOMPLETE. For safe compatibility, its per-run statuses are INCOMPLETE. Shared severity is INCOMPLETE > MESH_FAILED > NUMERICAL > SETTLED; DEGENERATE_REALISATIONS is an explicit INCOMPLETE subtype. Integrity refusals and session-deadline interruptions are INCOMPLETE. Outcomes are never assigned zero force. Realisation k deterministically rotates each polygon by k*floor(n/8) and shifts far-field boundaries by Halton(2,3)*ds, ground fixed; intervals describe this mesh-realisation mechanism, not gmsh randomness.

height_mm.description: Scene-bound physical ride height, checked against declared study height and the pressure reference; never a fixed default.

h_over_c1.description: Scene-bound physical h normalized by c1=223.4 mm.

h_over_c.description: Same physical h normalized by combined chord c=380 mm; always supplied in addition to h/c1.

delta_cl.description: Measured centre-section E2_original minus E1_original downforce coefficient, both re-normalized on c1. Positive downforce convention.

digitizing_uncertainty.description: Double-element reference uncertainty: sum over E2 elements of absolute reader-integral differences, per Amendment 1 §6. E1 sensitivity and full-difference sensitivity remain separately in provenance.reference_estimate. If >0.05*abs(delta_cl), TR-00 uses sign-only; equality uses ratio.

source.description: Required for formal CLI analysis, optional only in synthetic API fixtures. Record both single-element Table 15/Cl(h) extraction and double-element Cp integration in method/pages, use the centre-section observable, and provide at least two independently obtained digitization artifacts. Every artifact path and SHA must be bound by the study freeze input inventory.

path.description: Distinct artifact path, repository-relative or absolute; must appear in the study freeze inputs.

method.description: Independent person/tool and extraction/integration method; distinct files alone do not prove methodological independence.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL only for synthetic numerical API fixtures. REQUIRED for a formal CLI dataset: geometry_sha256 must contain exactly E1,E2,E3,E1_sharp,E2_sharp and equal the parent-owned study freeze's geometry_sha256 map of main-grid/unthickened-original JSON file hashes. The actual scene JSON files must also appear in that freeze input inventory. WP5 records actual source/runtime/freeze identities here; the study freeze binds this entire JSON by SHA-256. Confirmation-grid geometry is separately bound by its harness campaign; it is not substituted for the main RANS geometry.

realisation.description: SETTLED requires a non-null finite force and non-null mesh SHA for that config. The Python consumer enforces this cross-field rule and unique IDs; null is allowed only for failed/unattempted configs. Pair all configurations by id, not by accidental array order. Duplicate-mesh configurations are exported INCOMPLETE while preserving finite force diagnostics; cell_summary carries DEGENERATE_REALISATIONS and no interval. A MESH_FAILED result is neither solver nonconvergence nor infrastructure loss.

ci90.description: Collector emits point diagnostics only. WP4 owns intervals; a DEGENERATE_REALISATIONS cell must never be assigned an interval.

ratio_test_status.description: READY only establishes complete, settled, eight distinct meshes for this configuration; no qualification verdict.

thickening_difference.description: Descriptive thickened minus original mean, paired by realisation, always the same pressure-only or total observable on both arms, with both corresponding histories settled and both rows usable. No acceptance criterion. E3_sharp is not part of the registered solve matrix.
